storage.says: Footage, preview copies and finished videos are kept in a folder on this computer; a cloud storage bucket your team shares is the advanced choice.

database.says: Your projects are kept in a database on this computer: MetaRush downloads it from MongoDB (about 85 MB, free) and looks after it.

service.says: MetaRush starts when you log in and keeps running, so the dashboard is always there.

skills.says: Claude Code learns MetaRush's video skills, so you can edit by asking.
